mars.name: Dry Soil above the Ice Table

hammer_mass_kg.note: hammer ring 56 mm OD on the 18 mm spline x 22 mm

hammer_impact_velocity_m_s.note: m_h = 0.379 kg from CAD hammer geometry

impact_peak_force_n.equation: F = v Z_h Z_r / (Z_h + Z_r),  Z = rho c A

hammer_spring_natural_hz.note: must exceed 2 x blow rate so the hammer re-seats each cycle

percussive_min_wob_n.note: mean impulse flux the bit must react to stay seated

hammer_spring_wire_mm.equation: min d : all spring checks pass

hammer_spring_active_coils.note: >= 3 for a linear rate; squared & ground ends

hammer_spring_shear_mpa.note: F = k h = 750 N; allowable 690 MPa

hammer_spring_fatigue_fos.note: unpeened Zimmerli data, S_su = 0.67 S_ut; required 1.5

hammer_spring_slenderness.note: alpha = 0.5 (ends on parallel plates): absolutely stable, no buckling

bit_edge_radius_mm.note: Hertz line contact on a basalt clast; minimum 0.92 mm rounded up to 0.25 mm

bit_crushing_ratio.note: must exceed 3.0; hardest layer UCS 22 MPa

bit_index_spacing_gauge_mm.note: each blow strikes fresh rock this far from the previous crater at the gauge

sampling_flute_depth_mm.note: deepest flute whose root passes fatigue FOS 1.5 and yield FOS 1.25

sampling_pitch_mm.note: helix angle at mean radius below friction angle atan(0.32) = 17.7 deg

sampling_length_mm.equation: L_s = z_bite A_hole B m / A_flute
sampling_length_mm.note: A_flute = 283 mm^2 per mm, bulking 1.5, margin 1.2

choking_onset_bite_m.note: continuous penetration at which sampling flutes are full

transport_helix_angle_deg.note: maximises screw efficiency tan(a)/tan(a+phi) (Shigley power-screw result)

conveying_lift_ratio_moon.note: < 1: cuttings are not lifted continuously -> they stay in the sampling flutes (bite drilling). Continuous conveying would need > 188 rpm

conveying_lift_ratio_mars.note: < 1: cuttings are not lifted continuously -> they stay in the sampling flutes (bite drilling). Continuous conveying would need > 284 rpm

bit_junk_slot_width_mm.note: 2 slots x 5.0 mm deep; flute channel 80 mm^2

bit_braze_fos.note: tangential force 619 N per insert at the torque limit

bit_joint_shoulder_stress_mpa.note: FOS 16.2 on yield; impact passes through the shoulder, not the thread

bit_joint_thread_shear_mpa.note: right-hand thread: drilling torque tightens the joint

planetary_teeth.note: 3 planets: assembly (Z_s+Z_r)/n integer True, neighbour clearance True

rotary_motor_torque_nm.note: 6.5 N m at the spindle through 16:1, eta = 0.88

rotary_motor_rotor_d_mm.note: TRV = 20 kN m/m^3, L/D = 1.0; stack 30.9 mm

rotary_motor_stator_od_mm.note: frameless BLDC kit class; 3840 rpm max, 186 W shaft power at the torque limit

planetary_module_mm.equation: min m : sigma_b <= S_t/S_F and sigma_H <= S_c/S_H
planetary_module_mm.note: sun mesh F_t = K_g T_s / (n r_s); bending FOS 3.36, contact FOS 1.48

spur_module_mm.equation: Lewis: sigma = K_v F_t / (b m Y);  AGMA: sigma_H = Z_E sqrt(K_v F_t / (b d I))
spur_module_mm.note: 12T/24T, centre distance 22.5 mm; bending FOS 3.1, contact FOS 1.34

spur_contact_mpa.equation: sigma_H = Z_E sqrt(K_v F_t / (b d_p I))

cam_rise_deg.note: cycloidal rise, then a cliff that drops the hammer

cam_pressure_angle_deg.note: <= 30.0 deg (cycloidal: zero acceleration at both ends of the rise)

cam_torque_mean_check_nm.note: energy balance agrees with the integrated profile

cam_roller_contact_mpa.note: F = k h / 2 = 375 N per roller (two rollers); allowable 992 MPa

cam_gear_module_mm.note: 18T/54T ring gear on the cam; packaging-driven, bending FOS 35.93

percussive_motor_torque_nm.note: peak 0.898 N m; 2790 rpm at nominal spindle speed

spline_flank_pressure_mpa.equation: p = 2 T / (d z h_w L K), h_w = 0.9 m
spline_flank_pressure_mpa.note: Involute spline DIN 5480 W18x1.25x13, 16 mm anvil engagement; allowable 40 MPa (sliding hub)

spindle_torsion_fos.equation: tau = 16 T d / (pi (d^4 - d_i^4)); n = S_y / (sqrt3 tau)
spindle_torsion_fos.note: at the spline root d = 15.25 mm, bore 6 mm, tau = 9.6 MPa

leadscrew_offset_mm.note: Tr16 screw passes the cam-gear housing; bronze nut clamped in the top yoke

drill_head_height_mm.equation: sum of the derived axial stack
drill_head_height_mm.note: carriage underside to the top of the load-cell yoke

spindle_bearing_l10_h.note: SKF 7004 ACD/P4A pair, back-to-back: C = 1.62 C_single; F_a = WOB_lim + k h = 917 N, F_r = 126 N; required 400 h

upper_bearing_l10_h.note: SKF 61804 (thin section), floating; F_r = 588 N from the overhung 24T gear (F = 461 N)

cam_bearing_l10_h.equation: P = 0.56 F_r + Y F_a  (Y from f0 F_a / C0)
cam_bearing_l10_h.note: SKF 61812 (thin section): F_a = k h = 750 N, F_r = 59 N, Y = 1.52, 930 rpm; s0 = 27.8

load_cell_capacity_n.equation: min standard range >= factor x WOB_lim,max
load_cell_capacity_n.note: 334 N needed; error 1.25 N vs 5.0 N contact threshold

leadscrew_nut_pressure_mpa.note: Tr16x4 bronze nut 24 mm long, F = 179 N; allowable 11 MPa

leadscrew_self_locking.note: lead angle 5.20 deg: WOB cannot back-drive the screw when the feed motor is unpowered

flight_stall_plug_pressure_kpa.note: largest plug pressure the motor can push against before it stalls (screw-torque model)

flight_root_bending_mpa.note: flight strip L = 3.0 mm, t = 1.2 mm; yield FOS 15.3

flight_impact_inertia_mpa.equation: q = DLF rho t a,  a = (sigma/rho c) / (2 L_h / c)
flight_impact_inertia_mpa.note: wave-front acceleration 39,394 g, DLF 2.0: cycles at the blow rate

flight_required_cycles.equation: N = f_blow x t_drill x life factor

flight_weld_shear_mpa.note: static: 0.8 mm fillets, allowable 0.30 F_EXX = 321 MPa (ratio 5.6)

flight_weld_fatigue_life_cycles.note: stress range 136 MPa vs constant-amplitude limit 37 MPa (IIW FAT 63): fails the 3.7e+07-cycle requirement -> welded flights rejected

flight_root_fatigue_fos.note: integral flight, root fillet r = 0.5 t, K_f = 1.36; plug load as mean, blows as alternating

shank_braze_lap_mm.equation: L_b = max(3 t, 2 T FOS / (pi d^2 tau_b))
shank_braze_lap_mm.note: torque alone needs 0.18 mm; the 3 t lap rule (AWS) governs

shank_braze_fos.note: torque 7.0 MPa + pull-out at the 500 N load-cell rating 3.8 MPa; impact bears on the socket floor

hex_shank_torsion_mpa.note: inscribed circle of the 13.86 mm A/F hex (conservative vs Roark's hexagon); bore 6 mm

hex_socket_flank_pressure_mpa.equation: p = 2 T / (d_m h L n k)
hex_socket_flank_pressure_mpa.note: 6 flats, 52 mm in the anvil socket; allowable 40 MPa (as the spline)

hex_shank_impact_stress_mpa.note: net hex area 114 mm^2; yield FOS 21.1

retention_pin_shear_mpa.note: double shear at the 500 N load-cell rating (the largest pull the feed can apply and still measure)

auger_string_mass_kg.note: bit to anvil; flights add mass, not bending stiffness

string_buckling_load_n.equation: K phi = P K_g phi (bushing + hole wall as supports)
string_buckling_load_n.note: lowest over the stroke at 0.0 m; FOS 19.7 on the 167 N lift-off WOB

string_buckling_no_bushing_n.equation: clamped at the anvil, pinned at the bit only
string_buckling_no_bushing_n.note: FOS 3.5: still stable, the bushing is not needed for buckling

string_lateral_f1_hz.equation: K phi = omega^2 M phi, under the lift-off WOB
string_lateral_f1_hz.note: lowest over the stroke (start of the hole, longest free span); 1.77 x the 26 Hz blow rate

string_lateral_no_bushing_hz.equation: same model without the mast-foot guide bushing
string_lateral_no_bushing_hz.note: 0.75 x blow rate: inside the +/-20 % band, so the bushing is required

string_whirl_margin.note: first lateral mode vs the fastest shaft speed (no whirl critical speed in the RPM range)

string_torsional_f1_hz.equation: K_t phi = omega^2 J phi (clamped at the anvil, bit free)

string_windup_deg.note: at the 6.5 N m limit; the 6/4 mm sampling root is 80 % of the compliance

string_windup_energy_j.note: released into the bit if it breaks free after a stall (stick-slip)

thermocouple_path_fill.note: narrowest bore: sampling root 4 mm; lead 1.0 mm runs bit -> tube -> spindle -> slip ring

brush_tuft_count.equation: min N: tufts clear the flights (worm-wheel entry) and fit the hub
brush_tuft_count.note: tuft 9.4 mm thick in an 11.4 mm flute (backlash 1.0 mm each side), 1 mm hub ligament

brush_pitch_radius_mm.note: wheel circular pitch = flight pitch 13.0 mm

brush_axle_offset_mm.note: auger axis to brush axle (pitch circle on the mean flute radius)

brush_tip_radius_mm.note: tips pass 0.2 mm beyond the flute root

brush_tuft_lean_deg.note: tufts lean at the flight lead angle (worm-wheel helix)

brush_speed_ratio.note: 4.64 rpm at the 65 rpm transfer speed; transport pitch / sampling pitch = 3.00

cuttings_passive_pressure_kpa.equation: sigma_p = 2 c sqrt(K_p) + gamma h K_p
cuttings_passive_pressure_kpa.note: Rankine passive, K_p = 4.60; c = 1.0 kPa, Mars gravity, densest layer bulked

brush_contact_force_budget_n.note: string stiffness at the brush 294 N/m (bit tip) with the bit above the guide bushing

bristle_wire_mm.equation: thickest stock wire: Goodman, force budget, strip pressure
bristle_wire_mm.note: 17-7PH, free length 9.2 mm, 13787 bristles per tuft (60% fill)

bristle_stress_mpa.note: Goodman FOS 12.75 (0 -> sigma once per brush turn)

bristle_tip_pressure_kpa.equation: p = (3/16) phi E d^2 delta / L^3
bristle_tip_pressure_kpa.note: 13 x the cuttings' passive pressure: the root is scraped clean

brush_contact_force_n.equation: N = sum 3 E I delta_i / L^3 over the root contact

brush_sweep_speed_mm_s.equation: v = (2 sqrt(R_t^2 - (a - r_root)^2) / N_pass) x n/60
brush_sweep_speed_mm_s.note: root-contact patch 7.2 mm along the auger

brush_spring_preload_n.equation: F_pre = N (arm floats on the bristles)
brush_spring_preload_n.note: preload equals the required bristle force; the arm follows the string as it deflects

brush_spring_wire_mm.equation: thinnest stock wire: K_i 32 M / (pi d^3) x FOS <= S_sy/0.577
brush_spring_wire_mm.note: torsion spring on the 4 mm pivot pin: index 6.6, 3 coils, wound up 14 deg, 447 MPa

brush_force_rise_crown_pct.note: when the 0.5 mm gauge step of the bit crown lifts the brush

brush_bushing_pv_pa_m_s.note: Vespel SP-3 flanged bushing: 0.0025 % of the 0.35 MPa m/s limit

brush_drag_torque_nm.equation: T = F_plough r_m + mu N r_root + T_bush / N
brush_drag_torque_nm.note: plough 2.26 + bristle friction 0.65 + brush bushings 0.019 mN m (full flutes)

brush_idle_drag_torque_nm.equation: T = mu N r_root + T_bush / N
brush_idle_drag_torque_nm.note: empty flights passing the brush while drilling

chute_angle_deg.note: wall friction angle 21.8 deg on bronze (g-independent for dry flow)

sample_cup_id_mm.equation: pi/4 D^2 h >= V_bite x margin
sample_cup_id_mm.note: 62.4 cm^3 (120% of one bite); 55.5 mm deep, the most the 30 mm ground clearance under the foot plate allows

chute_flow_depth_mm.equation: h = Q / (w sqrt(2 g' L/2)),  g' = g (sin th - mu cos th)
chute_flow_depth_mm.note: brush delivers 0.60 cm^3/s; lunar sliding flow, 8 mm side walls; run 36 mm

carousel_stations.equation: N = ceil(depth / bite) cups + blank station
carousel_stations.note: 10 sealed cups, one per bite; the blank station sits under the port at launch and after the last bite

carousel_pitch_radius_mm.note: seal flange 42.8 mm, 4 mm between neighbours; axis 125 mm fore of the auger, port-cup flange 2.0 mm from the guide-bushing flange

carousel_mass_kg.note: turntable 272 g, 10 cups x 23 g, index motor 185 g; hung from the mast foot plate, which grows a disc of radius 105 mm to cover the cups

carousel_index_torque_nm.note: face seals 156 mN m + hub bearing 0.133 mN m + inertia 0.811 mN m (J = 81.3 kg cm^2, all cups full); motor rated 0.70 N m

carousel_index_power_w.note: 32.7 deg in 6 s while the auger descends, 0.45 J per index; empty and balanced at launch, so linear launch loads put no torque on the drive

brush_stow_angle_deg.note: arm swung away so the tips clear the bit gauge by 5 mm: launch lock + dry-heat bake-out position

mast_spine_fore_face_mm.note: rail brackets clear the Tr16 nut flange by 5 mm; carriage bushing pairs 262 mm apart

rail_span_max_mm.note: Ø16 rail between supports; end-supported over 1785 mm it would be 10 Hz

mast_stow_carriage_drop_mm.note: launch pose: carriage 701 mm below home, bit 491 mm through the foot. The nut splits the leadscrew and the guide bushing props the string (at home: screw 10 Hz, string 6 Hz)

leadscrew_stowed_f1_hz.equation: K phi = w^2 M phi: fixed top bearing, nut, support bearing
leadscrew_stowed_f1_hz.note: local mode (not the stowed primary); launch load 15.0 g (Miles 3-sigma vs 15 g quasi-static)

leadscrew_launch_stress_mpa.equation: sigma = M c / I (minor diameter d3)
leadscrew_launch_stress_mpa.note: yield FOS 2.5 (AISI 1045); peak sag 8.44 mm vs 15 mm to the rail brackets

string_stowed_f1_hz.equation: auger-string FE model with the bushing as launch support
string_stowed_f1_hz.note: local mode; launch load 15.0 g, peak bending 200 MPa (yield FOS 5.0), sag 9.71 mm

bit_side_force_n.note: one insert hung up on a clast at the torque limit: the largest unbalanced lateral force at the bit

bit_side_reaction_carriage_n.equation: R_A = 3 a F / (2 L), R_B = F + R_A
bit_side_reaction_carriage_n.note: string clamped at the carriage, propped by the bushing 96 mm above the bit: the foot takes 697 N

mast_section.equation: min (m_spine + m_posts + m_brackets) over feasible candidates
mast_section.note: 64 of 240 (material, section, brackets, latch height) candidates pass the deployed checks

mast_latch_height_mm.equation: latch posts: chosen with the section
mast_latch_height_mm.note: latch at z = 715 mm; 1182 mm of spine above it

rail_bracket_count.equation: spans <= L_max and the alignment budget
rail_bracket_count.note: 4 brackets, 357 mm spans (2 needed for the launch mode alone); rail flex tilts the carriage 441 urad

mast_spine_mass_kg.note: A = 924 mm^2 over 1807 mm; MGA 20% (AIAA S-120A)

mast_deployed_f1_hz.equation: K phi = w^2 M phi: hinge + latch, carriage over the drilling stroke
mast_deployed_f1_hz.note: 20.0-21.2 Hz from the start of the hole to 1 m; outside the rotary 1-4 Hz, cam 13 Hz and blow 26 Hz bands (+/-20%); 2% from the nearest band edge

mast_home_f1_hz.equation: same model, carriage at home (no percussion there)

mast_stowed_f1_hz.equation: hinge + hold-down(s), carriage at the stow pose
mast_stowed_f1_hz.note: requirement 50 Hz; 2 hold-down(s) (one at the crosshead alone gives 44.9 Hz)

mast_alignment_offset_mm.equation: e = w_c + phi_c L_cb - w_b at WOB_lim (+ side force)
mast_alignment_offset_mm.note: the string leaves the carriage 0.486 mm off the bushing axis vs the 0.5 mm bushing clearance

bit_alignment_error_1m_mm.equation: e = theta (z_bush + 1 m), theta = offset / L_cb
bit_alignment_error_1m_mm.note: string tilt 697 arc-s about the bushing at full depth (hole-wall guidance ignored)

mast_buckling_load_n.equation: P_cr = pi^2 EI_min / (2 L)^2 above the latch
mast_buckling_load_n.note: the spine is in tension while drilling; compression only when pulling a stuck string (510 N): FOS 218

mast_launch_stress_mpa.equation: sigma = M c / I, launch g = max(QS, Miles 3-sigma)

mast_rotating_mass_kg.equation: spine + rails + brackets + screw + carriage + crosshead + foot
mast_rotating_mass_kg.note: incl. the 3.2 kg carriage and string; MGA 20%

hinge_lug_load_n.equation: max(R_n/2, R_lat/2 + M/s, m g_ax / 2) at launch
hinge_lug_load_n.note: two Ti lugs 88 mm apart; the hinge also takes the launch load along the stowed mast

hinge_pin_d_mm.equation: min d: tau FOS_u <= S_u/sqrt3, bearing FOS_y <= S_y,lug
hinge_pin_d_mm.note: 17-4PH pin in double shear 257 MPa (FOS 2.4), lug bearing 303 MPa

hold_down_tension_n.equation: hold-down reaction, launch g = max(QS, Miles 3-sigma)
hold_down_tension_n.note: 2 hold-down(s); the hinge is the other support

hold_down_bolt.equation: min A_s: P_pre >= FS_sep FOS_u P_t and P_pre + FOS_u P_t <= S_u A_s
hold_down_bolt.note: A-286 frangible bolt, preload 15582 N (65% of yield); SMA release (Frangibolt class), no pyro shock

deploy_gravity_torque_nm.equation: T_g = m g_Mars max|dy cos th + dz sin th|
deploy_gravity_torque_nm.note: rotating mass 24.92 kg, CG 578 mm above / 141 mm fore of the hinge (home pose)

deploy_actuator_torque_nm.note: friction 0.069, harness 0.3, inertia 95.68 mN m (J = 19.74 kg m^2, 60 s); ECSS-E-ST-33-01C

deploy_motor_rotor_d_mm.equation: D_r = (4 T_m / (pi TRV lambda))^(1/3), T_m = T / (i eta)
deploy_motor_rotor_d_mm.note: 100:1 strain-wave gear, eta 0.6: motor 1795 mN m. Earth tests need a g-offload (141 N m at 1 g)

latch_pin_load_n.note: latch pin 6 mm, shear FOS 54: stiffness, not strength, sizes the latch

latch_engagement_energy_mj.equation: E = J w^2 / 2 at the end of the slew
latch_engagement_energy_mj.note: absorbed by the spring latch pin and a Vespel stop; the actuator brakes over the last 10 % anyway

leadscrew_buckling_load_n.equation: P_cr = pi^2 E I_3 / (0.7 L)^2 (fixed top bearing, nut pinned)
leadscrew_buckling_load_n.note: nut-to-top length 1330 mm at 1 m depth; FOS 12.0 on the 167 N lift-off WOB

leadscrew_critical_speed_rpm.note: 1785 mm between bearings; retraction 188 rpm = 34% of critical (limit 80%)

leadscrew_nut_launch_pressure_mpa.equation: p = m_c g_launch / (pi d_2 h_1 n_t)
leadscrew_nut_launch_pressure_mpa.note: launch along the stowed mast: the self-locking nut holds the carriage; allowable 11 MPa

lander_deck_length_m.note: the stowed mast lies aft over the deck; 0.60 m wide, top 0.45 m above the regolith

lander_cg_offset_m.note: drill 30.6 kg at y = 0.07 m, rest of lander 14.4 kg at the deck centre

lander_tilt_lift_off_ratio.note: a side-mounted drill unloads the near legs before the lander rises: tilt about the far legs 1.59 m behind the CG

lander_far_leg_line_m.equation: max(deck end + splay, y_G + e k / (FOS - k)), k = 1 + e_LC / WOB_set
lander_far_leg_line_m.note: WOB_set = m g / 1.4 is kept; near legs stay loaded at the set-point plus the load-cell error. Tilt margin 1.15 vs 1.4 for a drill through the CG

wob_tilt_limit_moon_n.note: set-point 52.07 N (margin 1.15); near legs 3.7 N, far 6.7 N each

lander_torque_reaction_fos_moon.equation: mu sum N_i r_i / T_max (footpads about the drill axis)
lander_torque_reaction_fos_moon.note: footpad friction alone reacts the 6.5 N m torque limit at the WOB set-point

wob_tilt_limit_mars_n.note: set-point 119.25 N (margin 1.15); near legs 8.5 N, far 15.3 N each

lander_torque_reaction_fos_mars.equation: mu sum N_i r_i / T_max (footpads about the drill axis)
lander_torque_reaction_fos_mars.note: footpad friction alone reacts the 6.5 N m torque limit at the WOB set-point

wing_axis_x_m.equation: x_w = W/2 + splay + sqrt((w/2)^2 + (h/2 sin beta)^2) + c
wing_axis_x_m.note: steepest tracking tilt 47 deg (Mars, Ls 90): the wing corner sweeps r = 0.74 m and clears the legs by 5 cm

wing_base_height_m.equation: z = deck top + azimuth platter + c
wing_base_height_m.note: wings ride on azimuth turntables at the ends of deck outriggers, at the lander CG station

critical_bit_temp_moon_k.note: <= 1 % ice loss from 25 um radius grains in 300 s (Murphy & Koop 2005)

critical_bit_temp_mars_k.note: prevents transient melting / refreezing of pore ice on the bit

warmup_duration_moon_s.equation: C dT/dt = Q_h - eps sigma A (T^4 - T_sky^4) - h A (T - T_amb)

warmup_duration_mars_s.equation: C dT/dt = Q_h - eps sigma A (T^4 - T_sky^4) - h A (T - T_amb)

bit_thermal_mass_j_k.equation: C = rho c_p V (crown + cutters + lowest flutes)
